data.name: Issi
data.gender_notes: Issi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Issi was a goddess of healing and childbirth. In the Christian tradition, Issi is considered a female variant of the Hebrew name Ishai, meaning 'man of God'. The name Issi is a reminder of God's healing power and His presence as a healer in our lives. The name Issi carries the meaning “God's Healer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Issi usually hope their child will grow to embody god's healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of healing and divine presence.
data.etymology: Issi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Healer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Issi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: איסי
in_hebrew.meaning: איסי הוא שם שפירושו ישוע או אלוהים יושיע
in_hebrew.long_meaning: איסי הוא שם עברי שמקורו בשם ישוע, שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא הישועה' או 'אלוהים יושיע'. השם ישוע הוא שורשו של השם איסי, והוא מופיע בתנ'ך כישוע בן נוח, שגם נקרא ישוע המשיח. השם איסי הוא צורה מקוצרת של השם ישוע, והוא משמש ככינוי חיבה או כצורה מקוצרת של השם.

in_greek.name: Ισσί
in_greek.meaning: Ισσί σημαίνει Θεός σώζει ή Θεός είναι η σωτηρία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ισσί είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος ישוע (ישוע), που σημαίνει 'Θεός σώζει' ή 'Θεός είναι η σωτηρία'. Το όνομα αυτό συσχετίζεται με τον Ιησού Χριστό, που στα ελληνικά είναι γνωστός ως Ιησούς. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ιησούς αναφέρεται συχνά, και αποτελεί τη βάση για διάφορες παραλλαγές ονομάτων, συμπεριλαμβανομένου του Ισσί.

in_latin.name: Issi
in_latin.meaning: Issi means God saves or God is salvation
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Issi is derived from the Hebrew name ישוע (Yeshua), which means 'God saves' or 'God is salvation'. This name is associated with Jesus Christ, whose name in Latin is Iesus. In the early Christian Church, the name Issi would have been recognized as a variant or diminutive form of Iesus, carrying significant religious connotations of salvation through Christ.
